definition: trying to hit the ball in baseball
description: At night on a baseball field lit by tall floodlights, seen from behind home plate, a batter in a helmet and dark gloves stands at the right edge with a wooden bat raised. In the middle of the field the pitcher in a white uniform throws, his leg kicking up behind him, and the white ball flies towards the batter. The batter swings, the ball flies high up into the dark blue sky, and the pitcher turns round to watch it. An empty grandstand and palm trees stand behind the field.

taps.phrase: to turn round on the mound
to soar into the night sky
